name: Loop signal (TokenEconomizer idea TE-T3)
summary: A transcript scan that flags sessions where the agent goes in circles. Setting --max-turns is the simpler alternative. The kill test first checks that flags are precise, then whether acting on them saves anything on the bench. Costs a transcript scan; nothing per session.

evidence.setting: Design idea; v8's version is unbuilt and unmeasured
evidence.effect: Agents that repeat failing steps waste turns; a signal could stop them sooner (expected, not measured)

killTest.hypothesis: A loop signal is precise enough to act on
killTest.pass: At least 1 flag per 50 turns with precision of at least 70%; then, on the bench, a gain of at least 10%

maintenance: Owned engine feature, maintained with the engine.
